findings.issue: لعلّ introduces a hedge ('perhaps there is good in it') that the English does not have. 'It's for the best' is a flat consoling assertion, and in this scene it is the line that settles the matter after the failed resurrection.

Undiacriticized كنت محقًا reads equally as كنتَ (you were right) and كنتُ (I was right) - and Sariel admitting he himself was right is a live misreading in a confession scene. The sibling line in TheDead_S1 disambiguates with أنك; this one does not.
